---
title: "Repository Workflow"
---

This repository uses GitHub issues, pull requests, Actions, and Pages as the
public engineering control surface for the Workbench.

## Defaults

- Repository: <https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench>
- Default branch: `master`
- Published site: <https://ashitaka-emishi.github.io/fspp-research-wrokbench/>
- Pages source: GitHub Actions
- Normal merge method: squash merge

## Issues

Tracked SDLC work should use the Markdown templates in
`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`. Each tracked issue carries a versioned
`fspp-issue-contract` marker with required sections for objective, scope,
branch prefix, evidence, permissions, and stopping conditions.

The older ad hoc issue-form scaffolding is intentionally not used for SDLC
work, because it does not carry the contract fields validated by the repository
helper.

## Pull Requests

Pull requests should state the research, data/schema, reproducibility, and
static-site consequences of the change. Changes to public-facing research,
provenance, codebook, validation, or workflow documentation should update the
relevant Quarto page in the same PR or explicitly explain why site parity is
deferred.

## Branch Protection

`master` should require pull-request review and relevant status checks when the
repository is connected to GitHub Actions. Repository-owner self-approval is a
maintainer policy choice, not a methodological shortcut: the PR still needs a
clear closeout record before merge and issue closure.
